Sub.description: A sub — BARE's only procedure form

Sub with return.description: A sub that returns a value

If / else.description: An if / else block — BARE has no elif

While.description: A while loop — BARE's only loop

Counted loop.description: Count from 0 with a while loop — BARE has no for

Loop over a string.description: Walk a string one character at a time by index

Print.description: Write a line to the console

Input.description: Prompt for a line of text

Input a number.description: Prompt for text and convert it to a number

Append to a list.description: Add a value to the end of a list

Random integer.description: A random number, rounded to a whole one
